Product Features

  • 7 zones of cut-good comfort & support Its surface is divided into areas of different sizes on both sides and a total of seven lying zones by a special cube cutting technique in order to be able to sink in and support your body optimally when lying on your side: Softer areas in the shoulder and hip area allow you to glide into the material so far that your spine is ergonomically correct.
  • All-round zipper cover washable: Thanks to the cuddly, breathable climate fiber cover, the cover ensures a pleasant sleeping climate. It can also be removed in no time at all thanks to the all-round zipper and cleaned in the washing machine. These are designed to make it easier for you to twist and turn the mattress.
  • Easy mattress care In order to meet the highest hygienic requirements, the mattress cover can be easily removed thanks to a circumferential zipper and machine washed at 60 °C. There are practical textile loops on the long sides of the cover. These are designed to make it easier for you to twist and turn the mattress.
  • Double the support, double the pleasure: Invest in a good night's sleep with a mattress that adapts to you. Whether you prefer the soft H3 cloud convenience or the added strength of H2, it's all within reach.
  • Sleep peacefully, no slipping: Experience undisturbed sleep on a mattress that is equipped with non-slip particles on one side. Say goodbye to movement and slipping and wake up refreshed and recharged.
